decision.reason: The immutable inspector cannot preserve exact HTTP response bytes, so production state cannot make this object safe to lease. Creator emergency remains independently held.

defect.actual: response="$(curl ... --write-out $'\n%{http_code}' ...)" stores the body in a Bash command-substitution variable before computing bytes, SHA256 and base64.
defect.impact: Bash removes every trailing newline from command substitution. A body such as x\n\n is reported as one byte instead of three and receives the wrong SHA256, contradicting the exact health/status/nodeIdentity/peerSync receipt contract.
defect.testGap: The focused self-test uses only the two-byte body {} and therefore cannot detect trailing-newline loss.

requiredSuccessor: capture each HTTP body as bytes without shell command substitution and without a remote temporary file
retain one request per endpoint and preserve exact status bytes SHA256 and base64 framing
add a direct remote-payload regression fixture for x followed by two newlines proving 3 bytes and its exact SHA256
retain four protected refs, one attempt per node, strict host checking, no retry and no remote temp files
recompute inspector, payload and printed-plan identities and force-false push a new exact successor
request a wholly-new lease only after Creator emergency cleanup reaches terminal release
